# SIDIS physics-results campaign

Unweighted and Spline stay separate. Neither campaign is the quoted result. A missing uncertainty is named. It is not entered as zero.

The acceptance-level budget is provisional. It is not the complete final systematic while radiative and bin-centering alternatives are outside the sum.

## Nominal correction stages

Acceptance `Bayesian`, then event-ratio `RC_Bayesian`, then event-based `BC_RC_Bayesian`. Each stage has its own fit file. B and C are not rescaled by the A0 factor.

### unweighted

- Weight tag ``, acceptance file `Sys3D_nominal_only_20261030_inherited_Unweighted.root`, status `verified`.
- acceptance fit `Fit_Pars_from_3D_Bayesian`: present. [path](../fits/unweighted/nominal/nominal/fit.json)
- rc fit `Fit_Pars_from_3D_RC_Bayesian`: present. [path](../corrected/unweighted/rc/fit.json)
- bc fit `Fit_Pars_from_3D_BC_RC_Bayesian`: present. [path](../corrected/unweighted/bc/fit.json)
- Latest normalization: `applied`, scope `provisional_acceptance_level`. [path](../corrected/unweighted/normalized_bc.json)

### spline

- Weight tag `Spline`, acceptance file `Sys3D_nominal_only_20261030_inherited_Spline.root`, status `verified`.
- acceptance fit `Fit_Pars_from_3D_Bayesian`: present. [path](../fits/spline/nominal/nominal/fit.json)
- rc fit `Fit_Pars_from_3D_RC_Bayesian`: present. [path](../corrected/spline/rc/fit.json)
- bc fit `Fit_Pars_from_3D_BC_RC_Bayesian`: present. [path](../corrected/spline/bc/fit.json)
- Latest normalization: `applied`, scope `provisional_acceptance_level`. [path](../corrected/spline/normalized_bc.json)
